name: Jibs Z-Image and ZIT Fantasy Art Lora combo
description: 18/02/2026 - Bonus SDXL Lora added. A pair of Fantasy Art Loras trained on the same 150 hand-picked Midjourney images. Z-image doesn't really need help achieving the style and it just changes the composition. The ZIT lora polishes the details in the refiner stage, it is a bit strong and I tend to use it around below 0.5 strength if generating with just ZIT. I really recommended to use both LoRAs (ZIB and ZIT) in my 2-stage workflow: https://civitai.com/models/2365846/jibs-double-turbo-zib-to-zit-workflow The Idea is that is that ZIT is not as good at art Loras on its own ZIB is better at art styles and prompt following, but lacks detail, so hopefully combining the 2 in a 2 Stage 2 model workflow gives the best of both worlds The ZIB Lora does seem to be making Z-Image outputs a lot darker in this first version.
